tasks.short: Receive and post weather and flight-plan information

steps.what: Receive actual weather and flight-plan source messages and verify source, flight identity, issue time and validity; capture any non-feed details manually
inputs: Actual authorized weather-service messages
Actual flight-plan messages and non-feed updates
outputs: Checked source messages and manually captured exceptions

steps.what: Map checked weather and flight-plan fields into an internal operations-board posting preview using exact approved identifiers and time formats
inputs: Checked messages and captured details from s1
Actual board-owner-approved field, flight and time mappings
outputs: Staged posting preview with original source and validity references and mapping exceptions

steps.what: Resolve posting exceptions and check every final field against the actual source, validity period, destination board and current supersession status
inputs: Complete posting preview and exceptions
Actual source messages and current board state

steps.what: Post the exact checked information batch to the authorized internal airfield operations board
inputs: Final checked posting batch and board destination

tasks.design: Configure a checked source-to-board staging integration in the airfield operations {OPS_SYSTEM}. Source verification and complete final posting checks remain explicit, followed by a separate gated internal post; no model alters or summarizes weather information.
tasks.previous_blocker: Weather and plan fields may be copied from source messages into a separate operations display.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing message formats and board import functions can stage exact fields with source and validity references.
tasks.still_hard: Stale, superseded or conflicting messages and correct flight and time identification.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist resolves operational ambiguity and confirms what is current and appropriate to post.

ambition.what: Remove actual repeated message-field entry before posting.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; operations and source owners authorize feeds, internal display and posting controls

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: authorized weather and flight-plan messages can be mapped deterministically into an internal posting preview with source and validity metadata.

assumptions: Authorized weather and flight-plan producers supply actual messages; s1 checks receipt and validity and captures non-feed details. No invented live feed, flight plan or clean exception record is assumed.

Missing identifiers, stale messages, unsupported formats or conflicts stop affected postings for manual resolution. The system does not calculate a route, change a flight plan or issue an ATC instruction.

s2 replaces actual retyping into a separate board; existing equivalent feed-to-display automation earns no new gain. The output is an internal information board, not an unreviewed external navigation publication.
Illustrative gross saving 40 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 36; same-system posting clicks have no saving.
unknowns: Actual feed access, current field re-entry and board preview capability
research_questions: Which source-message fields are manually copied today and can the board stage them without immediate publication?

already_counted.description: Verify actual source messages, capture exceptions and check the complete posting batch

incremental.description: Maintain exact source mappings and test stale-message and supersession handling

approvals.approved_version: Exact posting batch, current validity and board destination checked in s3; any source change requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured repeated-field posting scenario; actual source and complete final checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and check the actual current flight, weather, airfield and operational information needed for this departure or arrival briefing
inputs: Actual current flight and approved operational source records
outputs: Checked briefing sources and unresolved changes

steps.what: Select the relevant briefing points and check their final content, current source validity and intended crew audience
inputs: Checked current sources
Actual departure or arrival context and audience

steps.what: Conduct the actual departure or arrival briefing with the intended flight crew and address questions using checked operational sources
inputs: Final checked briefing content
Actual flight-crew questions

tasks.design: Configure a current-flight briefing-source view in the airfield {OPS_SYSTEM}. The specialist selects and checks actual briefing points before personally delivering the briefing and responding to crew questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current briefing sources can require navigation across several operations screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing flight-linked views can reduce source retrieval without ranking away information.
tasks.still_hard: Operational relevance, changing conditions and responding accurately to crew questions.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist understands the actual operation and can clarify uncertainty with the crew.

ambition.what: Reduce briefing-source navigation while retaining preparation judgment and delivery.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; operations owner approves current-source and crew-audience access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an operations system can provide a flight-linked view of current approved briefing sources.

assumptions: Actual source producers maintain flight and airfield information; s1 checks currency and gaps. No generated operational advice or automatic omission is proposed.

This scenario briefs an external airline crew; internal crews use the corresponding internal authority. Changed information is checked again before communication and unsupported answers are deferred for source confirmation.
No extra briefing report is invented. Actual required flight and event records are counted explicitly in task 10625, once if shared.
Illustrative gross saving 6 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1.5, net 4.5; actual briefing and questions remain fully counted.
unknowns: Current source-view coverage and actual retrieval effort
research_questions: Which current-flight briefing sources require repeated navigation today?

already_counted.description: Check actual sources and select and check final briefing content

incremental.description: Maintain briefing-source view and validity fields

approvals.approved_version: Final briefing content, source currency and crew audience checked in s2; changed content requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured briefing episode; only source navigation reduced after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on flight schedules and crew assignments

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual flight demand, aircraft and crew availability and the operator's approved scheduling constraints
inputs: Actual operations and crew-control records
Actual operator-approved scheduling constraints
outputs: Checked planning inputs and unresolved availability issues

steps.what: Collaborate with operations and crew-control colleagues to resolve flight-schedule and crew-assignment trade-offs
inputs: Checked planning inputs
Actual colleague constraints and judgments
outputs: Agreed proposed flight schedule and crew assignments

steps.what: Enter the actual proposed schedule and assignments in the planning workspace using existing flight and crew identifiers
inputs: Actual agreed proposal from s2
Existing flight and crew identifiers

steps.what: Compare the draft schedule and crew assignments with the exact approved availability and scheduling constraint rules
inputs: Draft planning record from s3
Checked approved rule and availability records from s1

steps.what: Resolve all conflicts with colleagues and check the complete final planning proposal against actual inputs and agreed assignments
inputs: Complete draft proposal and conflict listing
Actual colleague agreement and source records

steps.what: Save the final checked proposal in the same planning workspace for the operator's actual release process
inputs: Final checked planning proposal
outputs: Saved working schedule and assignment proposal

tasks.design: Configure actual flight and crew input views, identifier reuse and exact constraint checks in the planning {OPS_SYSTEM}. Colleagues choose the schedule and assignments, resolve conflicts and check the final working proposal before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated availability lookup, identity entry and manual constraint comparison can add planning effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing planning forms and approved rule tables can expose exact conflicts without making assignment decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Operational trade-offs, ambiguous availability and actual release authority.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist and colleagues balance actual operational needs and professional constraints.

ambition.what: Reduce mechanical planning checks while retaining collaborative assignment decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; operations and crew-control owners approve current rules, personnel access and planning boundaries

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: planning systems can reuse flight and crew identifiers and compare proposed schedules against explicit approved constraints.

assumptions: Operations and crew-control staff produce actual availability and approved constraints; s1 checks currency and missing inputs, and s3 captures real proposed assignments. No free clean roster is assumed.

The deterministic step checks supplied rules only; missing rules, conflicts or stale availability stop the proposal for actual colleague resolution. It does not infer legal limits or allocate crews autonomously.
This task produces an actual working planning proposal. Formal roster release, crew notifications and external flight changes remain with the operator's actual release process; no hidden send occurs.
Illustrative gross saving 23 per 100 task hours, upkeep 3, net 20; equivalent existing checks earn no new gain and same-workspace saving earns none.
unknowns: Actual planning role authority and existing constraint-check coverage
research_questions: Which flight and crew constraint comparisons are still manual in the current planning system?

already_counted.description: Check inputs, enter real proposed assignments and resolve and check the final proposal

incremental.description: Maintain approved planning rule and identifier mappings

approvals.approved_version: Final working planning proposal checked in s5; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured working-proposal scenario with manual exact-rule checks today; collaboration and final conflict resolution retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain flight, event and crew flying records

steps.what: Receive and verify actual incoming and outgoing flight events and crew identities and capture non-feed event details manually
inputs: Actual operations event messages and crew-control source records
Actual specialist-observed or reported non-feed events
outputs: Checked event inputs, crew identifiers and captured exceptional facts

steps.what: Map checked flight-event and crew fields into staged flight-log and crew-record updates with exact identifiers and time rules
inputs: Checked event and crew inputs from s1
Record-owner-approved flight, event, crew and time mappings
outputs: Staged flight-log and crew-record updates with source references and exceptions

steps.what: Write and check actual unusual-event details using the flight-linked event form and existing metadata
inputs: Actual captured exceptional facts from s1
Existing checked flight metadata
outputs: Complete draft event notes attached to the correct flight

steps.what: Resolve mapping exceptions and reconcile every final flight-log and crew-record update and event note against actual source events and identities
inputs: Complete staged log and crew updates and event notes
Actual source records and captured events
outputs: Final checked flight-log batch and final checked crew-record batch

steps.what: Commit the exact final checked flight and event log batch to the flight-operations records
inputs: Final checked flight-log batch

steps.what: Commit the exact final checked crew flying-record batch to the crew-record system
inputs: Final checked crew-record batch

tasks.design: Configure staged field transfer from actual operations and crew sources into flight and crew records in {OPS_SYSTEM}, plus a flight-linked event form. The specialist captures non-feed facts and reconciles both complete final batches before separate gated commits.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual flight and crew information may be copied from source messages or paper logs into separate records.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing record interfaces can stage exact source fields with explicit reconciliation and exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual events, missing messages, flight identity and crew-time discrepancies.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist investigates what actually happened and verifies the operational record.

ambition.what: Remove actual duplicate field entry while retaining capture and complete record checks.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; flight and crew-record owners authorize mappings, access and personnel-record use

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic interfaces can stage actual operations-event fields into flight and crew records with exact mappings and reconciliation.

assumptions: Operations message producers and crew control supply actual event and crew source records; s1 verifies them and manually captures any non-feed event facts. No clean event stream or uncounted paper transcription is assumed.
s2 replaces actual repeated entry into separate flight and crew records, not same-system save clicks. Existing equivalent record sync earns no new gain.
Missing or conflicting source events, unsupported time formats and unmatched identities stop affected updates for investigation; nothing fabricates an arrival, departure or crew time.
Illustrative gross saving 39 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 35. Both final commit clicks remain fully retained and have no saving.
Count source capture and record writes once if the same event appears in tasks 10624 or 10631; no hidden alert, regulatory filing or crew notification is sent.
unknowns: Actual duplicate record entry and current source interface coverage
research_questions: Which event and crew fields are copied between source messages, flight logs and crew records today?

already_counted.description: Verify and capture actual events, write event notes and reconcile both final record batches

incremental.description: Maintain source and identity mappings and review reconciliation failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact final flight and event log batch checked in s4; changed records require rechecking
Exact final crew flying-record batch checked in s4; changed records require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured current duplicate-record scenario; actual source capture, event writing and complete final reconciliation retained, upkeep deducted.
